name: Humalike x GTA RP
tagline: AI NPCs that talk, remember & act on their own
description: A new roleplay experience. Build characters and entire AI societies with memory, personality and voice that recognize players, form relationships and react to everything around them. Live on Poland's largest roleplay server. Now, add it to yours.

name: GPT-6 Sol & Luna
tagline: Frontier AI intelligence, now at half the price
description: OpenAI expands the GPT-6 family with Sol and Luna with faster, cheaper models trained like Astra. 50% lower API pricing, near-Astra factuality/coding/computer use gains, better prompt caching (90% off cached reads), and alignment improvements. Live in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and via API.

name: Cuey
tagline: Compare ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini answers in one tab.
description: AI gives you wrong answers in the same confident tone as right ones. Cuey cross-checks your AI's answer against ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and 30+ other models. It surfaces where they disagree and what your model missed. No copy-pasting between tabs, no repeating yourself, no extra subscriptions. Get a second opinion before you get burned by the first.

name: Superhuman Go
tagline: The AI assistant that works where you do
description: Go works inside Gmail, Slack, your docs, and your browser nudging better phrasing, drafting replies that sound like you, and prepping meetings before you think to. Add no-code agents that run on their own schedule. Free to start.

name: KiwiDesk
tagline: Tiling that feels like it shipped with macOS.
description: KiwiDesk is a tiling window manager for macOS that keeps your Mac calm and organized: every window finds its place in one of seven layouts, apps open with a shortcut, and mouse users get a Space Bar they can drag windows onto. It works with your native macOS Desktops: bind a profile to each one and it loads the moment you swipe there, with its own spaces, layouts, colors and shortcuts. Everything is set in a native Settings app, no config file needed. Free to use, source on GitHub.

name: Harmony
tagline: AI agents that resolve IT/HR tickets inside Slack and Teams
description: Harmony is an AI-native ITSM platform for IT teams. Instead of bolting a chatbot onto a ticketing tool, we built the helpdesk around AI agents: employees ask in Slack or Teams, and 100+ production-ready agents handle password resets, app access, onboarding, device issues and more end to end, escalating to a human only when needed. Ticketing, asset inventory, SaaS management and workflows live in one workspace, so agents have context to act. Teams hit 60%+ auto-resolution in days.

name: Clicks Communicator
tagline: A new kind of mobile communicator designed for doing
description: Clicks Communicator is a compact Android 17 phone built around a physical keyboard and a home screen for conversations. Use it as your main phone or a companion, with full 5G and apps while keeping messages, typing, and quick replies close at hand.

name: NiroHelp
tagline: Save time and money with AI-native support for WordPress
description: Support more customers with a smaller team and lower costs. NiroHelp’s AI uses your docs to answer customer questions in chat and reply to support tickets automatically. Customers get faster answers, while your team spends less time on repetitive questions. When AI is unsure, your team takes over. All inside WordPress.

name: Lofi Cities
tagline: Pixel-art city nights with endless, browser-generated lofi
description: Explore 16 animated pixel-art cities with endless lofi composed live in your browser. Choose from 9 music styles, change the weather, mix city sounds, and set focus or sleep timers. See how many people are in your city, send floating reactions, and release lanterns together. Take a city tour or explore on your phone. Free, no account needed, and works offline after your first visit.

name: QueroCura
tagline: the future of connected healthcare
description: Personalized care, right at home. From understanding your symptoms to remembering your next dose, QueroCura keeps your health story in one trusted place.

name: OpenScience
tagline: The open-source AI workbench for scientific research
description: OpenScience is an open-source AI agent for scientific research. It reads papers, writes and runs code, works in notebooks and a terminal, and sends long jobs to Modal, your own servers, or a Slurm/PBS cluster. Give it a metric and Autoresearch runs experiments, logs every one, and keeps hill-climbing. Use 30+ models through one wallet, sign in with ChatGPT, or run a local model. It ranks #1 on agentic scientific research benchmarks. Free and open source.

name: QuotaMint
tagline: Stop rebuilding credits and usage limits.
description: QuotaMint helps SaaS, AI, and API products manage credits, usage limits, plans, feature access, and usage tracking with one simple API. It works alongside Stripe, Paddle, Dodo Payments, or your existing billing setup, so you keep control of payments while QuotaMint handles what users can access and consume. Built for fast integration, it includes Test and Live environments, idempotent usage tracking, atomic credit deduction, and clear usage history.

name: FixMyFX
tagline: Free FX fee calculator, plus how to reduce your FX costs
description: A free, no-sign-up calculator for founders who sell or spend in foreign currencies. Enter your revenue and spend, see roughly what FX fees cost you per year, then get a plain-English plan to minimise these costs: receive and spend in the same currency (e.g. Wise or Airwallex + a local bank). Typically FX tools compare transfer rates; FixMyFX looks at your whole flow, income and spending. It runs entirely in your browser: your numbers are never collected or sent to a server.

name: Peas and Pans
tagline: Meal plans for nutrition coaches, sent under your own brand
description: Import a recipe from a link, photo, PDF or text. Each ingredient is matched to USDA FoodData Central; uncertain lines are flagged for you. Drag meals into a client's week and see day totals against their targets. Send it as a page and PDF with your logo on it.

name: GameRoll: Game Backlog Tracker
tagline: One app for your gaming life.
description: GameRoll brings your gaming life into one place. From current-gen consoles to classic retro systems: track your library spanning over 200 platforms in a single app. Organize your backlog and wishlist, rate and review games, discover trending and top-rated titles, and use Your Roll to decide what to play next. Follow gamers, join communities, discuss games, and share games you discover anywhere online. GameRoll is your home for everything you play.

name: Greypaint
tagline: Every Mac app up to date, with an undo button
description: Greypaint finds updates for the apps on your Mac, from the App Store, Homebrew and each app’s own updater, and installs them in one click. Every update is checked before it lands, and if a new version breaks something, you can roll back. $6.49, once.

name: Layoutr
tagline: Your floor plan, in 3D, then rendered by AI
description: Upload or draw your own floor plan, set the scale, and place real-sized furniture on it. Then lift the same plan into 3D: Dollhouse mode from above with your real wall height, or Inside mode at eye level so you can walk through it. Frame a view, name a style, and AI renders your room as a photorealistic image.

name: ShipWithMuse
tagline: Discover what people are building with Muse
description: A curated catalog of 1,000+ real Muse builds, experiments, tools, connectors, skills, and use cases. Search and browse by category, source, and build type, with every entry linked back to its original post, repo, video, or site.

name: Robin
tagline: An inbox that organises itself
description: Robin gives you an email inbox that organises itself. Use it for signups or forward your mail: login codes reach you, purchases and subscriptions get classified, and invitations land in your calendar. Gathers all your newsletter like a magazine. The point is liberating from email a bit. Agents should work in the background with the inbox for us. Inbox should be smarter by default.

name: Best AI Tools for One-Person Business
tagline: Practical AI tools for one-person businesses
description: Explore the best AI tools for one-person businesses, covering AI assistants, content creation, automation, research, customer support, analytics, and payments. Compare practical use cases, pricing, free plans, integrations, and limitations to find tools that solve real business bottlenecks without creating unnecessary complexity.
